coordinate_frame: CARLA world x forward, y right, z up for raw body; speed is signed body forward. Wheel force/slip are local tire longitudinal/lateral scalars, NOT world vectors. Wheel order follows PVehicle index; corner mapping not independently certified.

time.telemetry: No internal frame or timestamp field
time.association: sole tick owner; snapshot brackets around synchronous RPC must have identical frame; expected next frame checked after tick
time.force_time: debug fields read at RPC, substep aggregation/refresh phase not certified
time.forbidden: Do not claim same-frame force equals interval-averaged force or reconstruct exact solver impulse from it

steer/throttle/brake.kind: CARLA applied command, not smoothed PhysX input

engine_rpm.kind: engine state, engine model of Tesla blueprint, not electric motor validation

tire_friction.kind: contact friction coefficient, not Physics tire_friction scale

torque.semantic: engine debug wheel torque; decomposition into tire/brake/drive unavailable; NOT actual brake torque

long_force/lat_force.semantic: tire-axis debug force; not body net force or time-integrated impulse

normalized_long_force/normalized_lat_for.semantic: CARLA computed ratio, may be nonfinite at zero tire load; raw nonfinite represented explicitly, never zero imputation

derived_body_fields.acceleration: raw finite difference of signed snapshot speed, interval ending frame; API acceleration retained separately
derived_body_fields.jerk: difference of raw finite-difference acceleration; 50ms sample scale, not instantaneous solver jerk

invalid_handling: nonfinite engine fields preserved as invalid_raw text; absent fields raise; frame mismatch aborts batch
